title: solutions + pro services weekly sync - customer integrations 2026-03-03
content:
Meeting: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-03-03
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: #solutions-pro-services Slack + Zoom
Note-taker: Priya Nair
Attendees: Priya Nair (owner), Liam Chen, Aisha Gomez, Diego Martinez, Hannah Patel, Guest: Marco Ruiz (Customer Success)

Agenda:
- Quick status updates per customer (10 min)
- Blockers and escalation needs (10 min)
- Environment / infra capacity check (5 min)
- Legal/SOW / onboarding tasks (5 min)
- Action items + owners (15 min)

Summary / Highlights:
- Acme Corp: Integration validation in staging progressing; initial latency numbers look good but SSO handshake failing in prod test.
- NovaPay: Data ingestion pipeline validated; contract SOW pending legal signoff (minor clause updates).
- HealthSense: POC demo scheduled next Tue; need sample PHI-masked dataset and security questionnaire completion.
- Finlytics: Early performance regressions observed on long-context prompts; engineering to profile model variant.

Per-customer notes:
1) Acme Corp (Customer ID: ACME-101)
- Owner: Liam Chen
- Current stage: Staging validation -> preparing for production pilot (canary).
- Recent progress:
  - Prefix/KV caching enabled in staging for representative traffic (JIRA: SI-4521).
  - Throughput: 1200 RPS simulated with 95th p50 token latency ~170ms in staging (internal perf dashboard).
  - SAML SSO: SAML metadata uploaded, company IdP test passed on staging.
- Blockers:
  - Production SSO handshake failing intermittently (error: SAMLAssertionMissing). Root cause likely clock skew on their IdP.
  - Need confirmation from their IT on NTP sync and replay protection settings.
- Action items:
  - Liam to open support ticket with Acme IT and request NTP confirmation; target 2026-03-05.
  - Diego to add additional logging for SSO failures and correlate with timestamp; target 2026-03-04.
  - Priya to prepare runbook for SSO rollback (use email-login fallback) by 2026-03-06.
- Risks: Delayed SSO fix could push pilot start by 1–2 weeks.

2) NovaPay (Customer ID: NOVA-77)
- Owner: Aisha Gomez
- Current stage: Data ingestion + sandbox validation; contract near finalization.
- Recent progress:
  - Sandbox ingestion pipeline validated with anonymized transactions (sample size 50k).
  - Redaction + tokenization pipeline commercial profile tested; memory footprint OK.
  - Negotiated minor SLA edits with customer; legal needs to sign updated SOW (SOW v1.3).
- Blockers:
  - Legal signoff outstanding (internal legal requested a PCI-related clause tweak).
  - Need to finalize monitoring thresholds (alerting policy) aligned to their ops team.
- Action items:
  - Priya to follow up with Legal (share proposed clause language) — due 2026-03-04.
  - Aisha to sync with NovaPay ops on monitoring thresholds — schedule call by 2026-03-05.
  - Ops to provision dedicated logging retention for their sandbox (infra ticket INF-778).
- Notes:
  - Once SOW signed, plan 2-week production pilot with Dedicated pool.

3) HealthSense (Customer ID: HLTH-22)
- Owner: Diego Martinez
- Current stage: POC prep; security / compliance gating items remain.
- Recent progress:
  - Demo script drafted and reviewed; demo focuses on de-identified notes extraction.
  - Security questionnaire (third-party) partially completed; missing PHI handling descriptions.
- Blockers:
  - Customer needs assistance generating a PHI-masked dataset for the demo.
  - Our security must confirm HIPAA boundary controls for Private deployment option.
- Action items:
  - Diego to produce a one-page example PHI-masking guide and sample data generator (script) — due 2026-03-06.
  - Hannah to coordinate with Security for HIPAA scoping and provide short note for the customer — due 2026-03-05.
  - Schedule demo: 2026-03-10 at 09:00 PT (tentative).
- Risks:
  - If HIPAA scoping takes >2 weeks we may need to roll demo to a non-PHI dataset.

4) Finlytics (Customer ID: FIN-9)
- Owner: Hannah Patel
- Current stage: Internal performance regression investigation after model swap.
- Recent progress:
  - Customer reported degraded completion latency for >8k token prompts after switching to quantized 4-bit variant.
  - Engineering (serving-runtime) reproduced regression on internal harness (see GH PR linked).
- Blockers:
  - Unclear if regression due to kernel selection on our infra or an interaction with quantization schedule.
- Action items:
  - Hannah to file profiling trace (trace id: trace-fin-2026-03-03) and share with serving-runtime team — due 2026-03-04.
  - Serving-runtime to try fallback to non-quantized variant for 24h and report perf delta — target 2026-03-05 (JIRA: SI-4599).
  - Priya to prepare customer comms template for an incident update — due 2026-03-04.

Cross-cutting items / Platform updates:
- Infra capacity:
  - Dedicated pool capacity for March: currently 72% utilized. We forecast peak usage the week of 2026-03-15 for two enterprise pilots.
  - Reminder: submit requests for additional Dedicated capacity by 2026-03-09 (infra@redwood).
- Observability / Dashboards:
  - Diego added a per-customer SLO dashboard (beta) and linked it in Confluence. Feedback requested.
- Security & Compliance:
  - New customer security questionnaire template v2 posted to Confluence (see linked_artifacts).
  - For any PHI customers, Security requires completed BAA & Private deployment review before production.

Open blockers (company-wide):
- Legal signoff backlog: 3 SOWs pending (NOVA-77 highest priority).
- SSO production instability across 2 customers (ACME-101 + one internal staging issue).
- Performance regression on quantized variant (FIN-9).

Decisions made this week:
- Proceed with Acme pilot as soon as SSO fix verified; use email-login fallback until resolved.
- For Finlytics, do a 24h non-quantized fallback before rollback decision.

Action items (consolidated):
- Liam: Open support ticket with Acme IT re: NTP + SSO logs (due 2026-03-05).
- Diego: Add SSO failure correlation logs + publish quick findings (due 2026-03-04).
- Priya: Draft SSO rollback runbook & customer incident template (due 2026-03-06 and 2026-03-04 respectively).
- Aisha: Schedule monitoring thresholds call with NovaPay ops (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya: Follow up with Legal on NovaPay SOW clause language (due 2026-03-04).
- Hannah: Coordinate HIPAA scoping with Security for HealthSense (due 2026-03-05).
- Diego: Produce PHI-masking guide + sample generator (due 2026-03-06).
- Serving-runtime team: Profile quantized variant regressions and test non-quantized fallback (due 2026-03-05).

Notes / To remember:
- Link to perf dashboards in Slack: #perf-dash (ask for access if missing).
- Use template 'customer-onboarding-checklist-v1' in Confluence before moving to pilot.
- Keep customer comms conservative; share measured metrics not subjective language.

Questions for the group / decisions needed from leadership:
- Approve expedited infra capacity request if both NovaPay and Acme pilots go full prod (estimate +50% GPU burst). Who signs off? (ask infra/product leadership).
- For customers requiring PHI, do we push for Private deployment only or consider hosted with strict BAA controls? Need final decision from Security/Product.

Next meeting: 2026-03-10 10:00 PT (weekly cadence)

Appendix / Useful links referenced in notes:
- JIRA: SI-4521 (Acme SSO)
- JIRA: SI-4599 (Finlytics perf regression)
- Confluence: Integrations/Customer-Onboarding
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 (serving-runtime profiling patch)
